title: alyssum minus
intro: Alyssum minus, commonly known as Sweet Alyssum or Dwarf Alyssum, is a small, flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is known for its tiny white flowers that emit a sweet fragrance, and is often used as an ornamental plant in gardens and landscapes. The health benefits of Alyssum minus include its potential to reduce anxiety and stress, improve sleep quality, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, due to its therapeutic actions of promoting relaxation and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Alyssum minus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and fragrance.
